blocks.prompt: 4. [Prove by mathematical induction, for every positive integer \(n\):] \(x - y\) is a factor of \(x^n - y^n\); \((x \ne y)\)
blocks.explanation:
"\(x - y\) factor hai \(x^n - y^n\) ka" ka matlab hai: \(x^n - y^n = (x - y) \times\) (koi polynomial). Polynomial yani \(x\) aur \(y\) ki powers se bani terms ka jama.
Yeh numbers ki jagah algebra wala divisibility proof hai.
Plan: \(x^{k+1} - y^{k+1}\) mein \(xy^k\) ko ek dafa minus aur ek dafa plus karna, taake purana expression \(x^k - y^k\) saamne aa jaye; phir hypothesis lagana aur \(x - y\) common nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(n): x - y\), \(x^n - y^n\) ka factor hai, \(x \ne y\).
Saabit karna hai: \(S(n)\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye sahi hai.
Tareeqa: Mathematical induction. Statement ko equation bana lein: \(x^n - y^n = (x - y)P_n\), jahan \(P_n\) koi polynomial hai.

Base case: \(n = 1\) rakhein
\[x^1 - y^1 = (x - y) \times 1\]
Is liye \(S(1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Har expression apna factor khud hota hai (1 se multiply). Yani \(n = 1\) par \(x^1 - y^1\) bilkul \(x - y\) hi hai, is ko \(x - y\) se divide karein to 1 aata hai aur koi baqi nahi bachta.

Induction hypothesis: \(S(k)\) ko sahi maan lein
\[x^k - y^k = (x - y)P_k \quad (A)\]
Kyun: \(S(k)\) kehta hai ke \(x - y\), \(x^k - y^k\) ko poora divide karta hai, is liye quotient \(P_k\) ek polynomial hai.

Target \(S(k + 1)\)
\[x - y\ \text{is a factor of}\ x^{k+1} - y^{k+1}\]
Kyun: \(n = k + 1\) rakha.

\(xy^k\) ko minus aur plus karein
\[x^{k+1} - y^{k+1}\]
\[= x^{k+1} - xy^k + xy^k - y^{k+1}\]
\[= x(x^k - y^k) + y^k(x - y)\]
Kyun: Ek hi term ko minus aur plus karne se value nahi badalti (jaise \(-5 + 5 = 0\)), lekin is se purana expression nikal aata hai. Pehle jore mein \(x\) common: \(x^{k+1} - xy^k = x(x^k - y^k)\). Doosre jore mein \(y^k\) common: \(xy^k - y^{k+1} = y^k(x - y)\), kyunke \(y^{k+1} = y^k \cdot y\).
Dhyan dein: Yeh "add and subtract" wali chaal yaad rakhiye; aisi bohat si proofs isi se khulti hain.

Inductive step: (A) lagayein aur \(x - y\) common nikalein
\[= x(x - y)P_k + y^k(x - y)\]
\[= (x - y)[xP_k + y^k]\]
Kyun: (A) se \(x^k - y^k\) ki jagah \((x - y)P_k\) rakha. Ab dono hisson mein \(x - y\) maujood hai, usay bahar nikala.

Nateeja parhein
\(xP_k + y^k\) ek polynomial hai, is liye \(x - y\), \(x^{k+1} - y^{k+1}\) ka factor hai. Yani \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: \(P_k\) polynomial hai, \(x\) aur \(y^k\) bhi polynomials hain; polynomials ka product aur jama bhi polynomial hi hota hai. Is liye bracket koi aam sa algebraic expression hai, aur \(x - y\) us ka factor ban kar bahar khara hai.

Conclusion
\(S(1)\) sahi hai aur \(S(k)\) se \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hota hai. Principle of mathematical induction se \(x - y\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(x^n - y^n\) ka factor hai.
Kyun: Induction ki dono sharten poori ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 3\)
\[x^3 - y^3 = (x - y)(x^2 + xy + y^2) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh difference of cubes ka jaana pehchana formula hai, jis mein \(x - y\) factor saaf nazar aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x - y\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(x^n - y^n\) ka factor hai.
